verdict.rationale: Square has a dedicated first-party docs page titled "Test in Sandbox" in its developer tools section, which shows a sandbox testing environment exists for its APIs. The pack contains only the page title, so isolation from production data and agent-specific use are implied rather than evidenced. Missing for 10: documented details of sandbox/production separation (separate credentials, test data, base URLs), evidence that the MCP server or agents can target the sandbox, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
